targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-07-22 (V3-EXQ-786a, EVIDENCE, claim_ids=[MECH-163], weakens; failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-786a_2026-07-22). `weakens` STANDS, scoped to leg (1) ONLY. This is MECH-163's first genuine V3 experimental evidence (the 2026-04-03 hold recorded 9 lit supports, 0 experimental entries). The test was fair and the instrument was repaired first: the manipulation check passed on both legs (familiarity discriminability AUC 0.848 vs a 0.7 bar; SEM lower bound 0.795 vs the 0.5 null), replacing 786's raw mean-difference floor of 0.05 which was neither scale-free (the readout's units are set by the tracker's bandwidth/EMA, so re-tuning the instrument moved the gate) nor an overlap measure. n=8, non_degenerate:true. The load-bearing criterion C1_recruitment_higher_on_novel failed on BOTH the absolute and standardized legs: recruitment delta mean 0.00435, SEM 0.0325, lower bound -0.0281 against a 0.02 margin, Cohen's d 0.047. That is an ABSENT effect, not an underpowered one -- do not route to a power re-run. SCOPE: leg (1) novel-context recruitment ONLY. Leg (2) long-horizon benefit accumulation is blocked by ARC-007 STRICT value-flat proposals; leg (3) prosocial planning has no V3 substrate; and ARC-071 (planned->habit transfer) -- which the 2026-05-10 targeted_review_arc_071_composition synthesis (lit_conf 0.848) established is the missing transition mechanism MECH-163 presupposes but does not specify -- is UNBUILT. The null's shape is diagnostic: a flat response (7 of 8 seeds within +/-0.15) is the signature of two pathways with NO ARBITRATOR, and in the reference biology differential recruitment is produced by uncertainty/reliability-based arbitration, not by the existence of two pathways. Read as positive evidence for the necessity of an arbitration element. lit_conf and exp_conf must be reported SEPARATELY -- 9 lit supports and 1 experimental weakens do not blend.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Uncertainty/reliability-based arbitrator that reallocates control between the two MECH-163 pathways -- differential recruitment is produced by arbitration, not by the existence of two pathways
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: V3-EXQ-786a measured a FLAT recruitment response (delta mean 0.00435, Cohen's d 0.047, 7 of 8 seeds within +/-0.15) with the manipulation check passing at AUC 0.848 -- the signature of two pathways and no arbitrator. Build an uncertainty- or reliability-based arbitration element per the Daw and Lee/Shimojo/O'Doherty reference (vlPFC/FPC reliability arbitration), which is also the mechanism ARC-071 (planned->habit transfer) presupposes. Without it, differential recruitment under novelty cannot be expressed regardless of how discriminable the contexts are.

learning_extracted: MECH-163's first genuine V3 experimental evidence is a null on leg (1), after a 2026-04-03 hold_pending_v3_substrate with 9 lit supports and 0 experimental entries. Report lit_conf and exp_conf separately -- they do not blend.

The null has a specific biological shape: NO ARBITRATOR. Delta mean 0.0044 with d 0.047 and 7 of 8 seeds within +/-0.15 is a FLAT response. In the reference biology differential recruitment is produced by an uncertainty/reliability arbitrator, not by two pathways existing. This FAIL is therefore positive evidence for the necessity of an arbitration element -- exactly what ARC-071 names and the substrate lacks.

786's manipulation-check repair is validated and generalisable: replacing a raw mean-difference floor with an AUC bar makes the gate scale-free with a principled null at 0.5, closing the 're-tuning the instrument moves the gate' hazard. Adopt wherever a manipulation check is currently a raw-difference floor.
More seeds will not rescue this. sample_size_improvable:true is technically correct but with d=0.047 the effect is absent at the scale the claim predicts, not underpowered.

granularity_debt_trigger.basis: Second autopsy on MECH-163 with a DIFFERENT failure signature: 786 was an instrument defect (non-scale-free manipulation-check bar), 786a is a substantive null with the instrument repaired. The claim bundles three legs with three different blockers -- leg (2) blocked by ARC-007 value-flat proposals, leg (3) with no V3 substrate at all, leg (1) nulled without ARC-071. That is the granularity-debt shape: a coarse claim that is several claims.
